title: Workspace manager UI: instances, add folder, recursive scan
description: SPEC.md §5 row 23: web UI surface for the instance model — instance switcher in the chrome, add-folder flow, recursive-scan flow with discovered-project picker, loaded/lazy indicators, suggestions from ~/.claude/projects known repos. Mirrors the Ink CLI's capabilities.

title: Multi-root instance model: lazy load, unload, persistence
description: SPEC.md §4.2: one server hosts many instances. Instance = {root, markers, state: lazy|loaded}. Full engine run + watcher start on first open; idle unload; instance list persisted to ~/.local/state/agentconfiging/workspace.json and restored on launch. API: list/add/remove/open/scan endpoints (token-guarded like everything else).

title: Recursive agent-project discovery walker
description: SPEC.md §4.2: given a directory, find agent-configured projects beneath it — marker-file walk driven by the detector signal tables, bounded depth, SKIP_DIRS honored, symlinks never followed, cheap (records {root, markers} only, no content reads). Powers 'scan folder recursively' in CLI and web UI.

title: Instruction sync: source of truth + regenerate all runtimes
description: SPEC.md §5 row 22 and §4.1: bidirectional mapping between runtimes' instruction/rule formats. User designates a source of truth (CLAUDE.md or canonical rules dir); regenerate other runtimes' instruction files from it with diff preview; per-runtime sync-status indicators; wire as the one-click resolve action on conflicting-instructions and rules-drift findings. Long-tail formats (Cline, Windsurf, Zed, Amazon Q, Junie, Roo, Qodo) as sync targets.

title: DECISION: npm package + bin name
description: 'agentconfig' is taken on npm (johnlindquist, owns agentconfig bin). Available 2026-07-26: agent-config, acing, agentconfiging. Aaron already publishes acing-cli + @capabletooling/agentconfiging. Needs Aaron's call before publish; update package.json + docs after.
notes: Investigation 2026-07-26: npm 'agentconfig' is held by johnlindquist — but effectively abandoned. He published 1.0.0-1.1.1 in a 5-hour window on 2025-06-17, then renamed the project to 'dotagent' the NEXT DAY (npm dotagent created 2025-06-18, now v2.10.0, actively maintained; GitHub repo renamed johnlindquist/agentconfig → johnlindquist/dotagent, 144 stars). The agentconfig npm name has been frozen at 1.1.1 since day one. Options: (a) email johnlindquist@gmail.com asking for a friendly transfer — plausible since he abandoned the name within 24h for dotagent; (b) npm support name dispute (weaker: he did publish real code); (c) fall back to free names: acing (matches acing-cli heritage) or agent-config. His tool is a rules-format converter (Copilot/Cursor/Cline/Windsurf/Zed/Codex/Aider ↔ unified .agentconfig format) — adjacent prior art, not a competitor to our control center.
close_reason: Decided: npm package + bin = agentconfiging (agentconfig.ing without the dot, matches @capabletooling/agentconfiging). bare 'agentconfig' held by another author since 2025-06-17, abandoned for their dotagent rebrand — friendly transfer request remains a future option (see notes). SPEC.md §2 updated.

title: Skills & agents editor with connections view

title: Settings editor: global + project, permissions, env, storage cleanup
description: SPEC.md §5 row 2: model selector, effort, allow/ask/deny permissions editor, env vars, statusLine, shared vs local overrides side-by-side, disk usage breakdown with safe one-click cleanup.

title: Findings page with severity filters and APPLY affordance stubs
description: Timetable FindingRows, filter by severity/agent, fix line shown; APPLY buttons disabled until E5 wiring.

title: App shell: left rail, top bar, routing, WS client state
description: Numbered left-rail nav (01 SIGNAL...) doubling as Cmd+1..9, top bar with project path + LIVE + theme toggle, WS client with report store and reconnect.

title: Overview dashboard: stat blocks, SignalStrips, findings summary
description: Giant numerals (agents/warnings/artifacts), per-agent SignalStrip rows with waveform + confidence meter, top findings.

title: Core components: StatBlock, FindingRow, FileChip, DiffPanel, buttons, tables, EmptyState
description: Per DESIGN.md §6 specs. Bracket-label buttons ([APPLY]/[COMMIT]), hairline tables, NO SIGNAL empty state.

title: Signal layer primitives: waveform, VU meter, LIVE dot, sweep
description: DESIGN.md §5: canvas waveform fingerprint deterministically derived from config hashes (pulses on file events), segmented VU meters, square LIVE dot with OFFLINE state, 300ms rescan sweep. Full prefers-reduced-motion degradation.

title: Tokens, themes, type, grid CSS foundation
description: DESIGN.md §2-4: Paper+Ink CSS custom properties, Archivo + IBM Plex Mono loading (self-hosted), 8px baseline, visible-grid layout primitives, micro-label + giant-numeral type classes. No component kit, no Tailwind.

title: Watcher + WS live report push
description: chokidar over config paths + history files, 150ms debounce, rerun engine, structural report diff, push {type:'report', changed} over authenticated WS.

title: Security test suite: rebinding, CSRF, traversal
description: Automated tests: request without token 401, wrong Origin rejected, Host mismatch rejected, ../ and symlink escapes blocked, non-localhost bind impossible. Documents the threat model from SPEC.md §4.2.

title: Write API: dry-run diff, commit, trash delete, path guards
description: Every mutation has dry-run returning unified diff; commit applies; deletes to trash. Writes restricted to known config paths under project root + agent home dirs; canonical-path traversal guard; symlinks not followed out of scope.

title: Hono server: static UI + report API with token auth
description: Serve dist/web, GET report endpoints. Every request requires bearer token; strict Origin/Host checks; no CORS. 127.0.0.1 bind only.

title: Ink CLI app: instance list, log pane, launch flow
description: SPEC.md §5 row 24, DESIGN.md §8: Ink + commander. Header, instance list (loaded/lazy status), <Static> log pane; keys: j/k select, enter opens browser, a add folder, s recursive scan, q quit (--detach keeps server). Random port + session token + browser open. Logs mirrored to ~/.local/state/agentconfiging/logs/<timestamp>.log (AGENTCONFIGING_LOG_DIR override); path printed on start/crash. NO_COLOR + non-TTY degrade to plain lines; 'report' and 'daemon' never use Ink.

title: 'agentconfig report' CLI command
description: Run engine over cwd, print full JSON report to stdout (CI-friendly, exit code by max severity). The E1 demo gate.

title: History readers: history.jsonl + session JSONL adapters
description: Typed readers for ~/.claude/history.jsonl and ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/*.jsonl. Honor markdowning adapter lessons: lossy cwd slugs (read cwd from entries), variable first line, sidechain markers, tool-result spill files, ai-title lines. Multi-runtime adapter interface (claude first; codex/gemini/opencode later).

title: Analyzers + machine-fix model
description: Port the 9 Elixir analyzers where sensible; replace word-count heuristics with parser-aware versions; add: subagent references missing tool, MCP command not on PATH, hook script missing, broken @import, duplicate/shadowed rules. Findings carry optional fix {kind, edits:[{path,patch}]}. Stale-model data in a data file.

title: Detectors: 8 runtimes with auto-discovery and confidence
description: Port claude-code, cursor, copilot, codex, continue, aider, gemini-cli, opencode signal sets from the Elixir detectors. Directory-based module auto-discovery (no hardcoded list). extras as open metadata bag.

title: Scanner + Manifest with project and global scopes
description: Port KNOWN_FILES/KNOWN_DIRS/SKIP_DIRS/ALLOWED_EXTS from markdowning cli scanner.js verbatim. Symlink + NUL-byte binary guards. Manifest {root, files:[{path,size,sha256,content}], stats}. Global scope reads ~/.claude etc., flagged local-only.

title: Structural parsers for every config format
description: YAML frontmatter (yaml), TOML (smol-toml), JSON. Typed models: Claude subagents, skills, commands, rules, settings.json (permissions/hooks/env/statusLine/model), .mcp.json + mcpServers, keybindings.json, memory frontmatter, .cursor/rules/*.mdc, Copilot instructions, AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md, @import refs in CLAUDE.md. Resilient to malformed input (it is adversarial data).

title: Fixture corpus: real-world agent config trees as JSON manifests
description: Harvest anonymized fixtures covering all 8 runtimes + rich .claude trees (agents, skills, commands, hooks, MCP, rules, memory, keybindings) + history.jsonl samples. These drive all engine tests.

title: CI: lint, typecheck, test, build on push
description: GitHub Actions (or local equivalent until remote exists): node 20 + 22 matrix, cache, full pipeline gate.

title: Package scaffold: TS monopackage, tsup, vite web shell, vitest, lint
description: src/core, src/server, src/cli, web/ layout per SPEC.md §4. npm scripts: dev (server+vite), build, test, lint. Package name and bin: agentconfiging (decided — SPEC.md §2).

description: Diff-preview write flow, then editors for settings (global+project), instructions/CLAUDE.md with @imports, skills/agents with connections view, hooks (22 events), rules, memory, MCP servers, keybindings; one-click APPLY for machine-fixable findings. SPEC.md §5 rows 2-8, 19.

title: E4 Inspector: overview, agent detail, artifact browser, findings
